repo_prior_art.cite: stat_functional_did_sparse_frontier, “raw irregular-measurement functional ATT minimax frontier,” is a different DiD, point-identified experiment.

published_prior_art.cite: bergerhermannholzmann2025supnorm gives additive functional-mean minimax regimes; pengstijvenwanggilbert2026 gives bounded-tuple nonidentification, not an RD complete-mixture frontier.

repo_prior_art.cite: stat_functional_did_sparse_frontier has raw-functional-DiD multiplier bands, not a complete-mixture identification-diameter band.

published_prior_art.cite: caihu2025simultaneous gives additive functional-mean bands; vandijcke2025r3d gives empirical-quantile R3D bands under Q1, not the claimed two-resolution honest-width frontier.

pengstijvenwanggilbert2026 establishes bounded-tuple barycenter nonidentification, while vandijcke2025r3d and ZhouMuller2024 address sampled distributional regression without this sharp RD operator modulus.

vandijcke2025r3d and pengstijvenwanggilbert2026 provide asymptotic bands under their respective empirical-quantile or structural-model conditions, but not the requested no-variance-lower-bound operator frontier.

novelty_flags.label: related_work and prop:r3d-direct-identification
novelty_flags.one_line: They call Van Dijcke's Q1 a direct-target continuity condition, but Q1 is the empirical-quantile approximation-rate condition; direct identification uses I1 continuity.

novelty_flags.label: thm:generic-risk-frontier and thm:generic-honest-frontier
novelty_flags.one_line: Zhou and Müller (2024), omitted from the core, is a closer growing/variable within-distribution-sampling comparator than the cited additive-functional papers and must be positioned against the R3D resolution claim.

novelty_flags.label: thm:generic-risk-frontier
novelty_flags.one_line: The consumer invokes unspecified “marked latent-feature studies” and calibration of R3D even though the stated limitation concedes iid R3D draws lack the stable marked decoder; no transfer theorem or real deployed marked-channel setting is named.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:r3d-operator-index
soundness_flags.one_line: The proposed exponent nu_R3D(beta,gamma) contains gamma, which is neither declared nor given a statistical or operator meaning.

soundness_flags.label: def:randomized-band and thm:generic-honest-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: A verbal centered “local-polynomial influence process” does not define residuals, weights, variance estimation, or endpoints, while H requires exact all-n honest coverage; state a complete finite-sample band or an explicitly asymptotic honesty claim with conditions.

soundness_flags.label: ass:r3d-latent-density
soundness_flags.one_line: The Peng et al. citation does not support a Hölder ball for every latent F_d bounded above and below; it studies arbitrary latent distributions and uses a lower density condition only for a different mixing distribution in a proof.

soundness_flags.label: ass:marked-channel
soundness_flags.one_line: Known, uniformly nonvanishing signals for conditionally independent binary probes of every coordinate of an infinite latent sequence are load-bearing, while the asserted questionnaire/instrument examples do not establish that this calibration model is realistic.

source_verification_receipts.version: October 6, 2025 manuscript, the exact version named in the bibliography
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 10–12, I1 and Lemma 1; pp. 25–26, Q1; p. 30, Proposition 2 and Corollary 3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: I1, not Q1, is continuity of E[Q_{Y^t}(q)|X=x] and yields the cutoff identification formula. Q1 requires uniform empirical-quantile estimation errors r_ni with sqrt(nh) max_i r_ni -> 0; Proposition 2 and Corollary 3 then give empirical-quantile process and band conclusions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 2.1, pp. 4–5; Proposition 3.1, p. 9; Appendix A.1; Corollary 6.4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper observes iid draws from arbitrary latent distributions, proves bounded-sample barycenter-quantile nonidentification, and gives a Gaussian-process result under structural and positive-variance conditions; its bounded-away-from-zero density in Lemma A.1 concerns an auxiliary mixing measure, not Hölder densities of every latent F_d.

source_verification_receipts.version: Statistics and Computing 35, article 146, version of record, July 13 2025
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published article develops unified Gaussian approximation and simultaneous confidence bands for functional-data mean functions across sparse-to-dense observation schemes.

source_verification_receipts.version: public revision corresponding to Econometric Theory 40 (2024)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper motivates split-panel jackknifing by a leading m^-1 bias expansion for distribution and quantile-function estimation from noisy draws.

The paper studies Wasserstein regression from empirical measures under sparse and varying within-distribution sample sizes, explicitly addressing when preliminary distribution recovery can be ignored.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace every Q1-as-continuity reference with Van Dijcke's I1, add the Q1 growing-within-unit condition as the direct R3D comparator, and position Zhou–Müller against the proposed resolution exponent.
Define gamma and a primitive R3D operator class, then either prove a transfer from iid latent draws to the marked decoder regime or stop presenting the generic theorem as an R3D calibration theorem.
Give the randomized band an explicit residual estimator, local-polynomial weights, covariance/studentization rule, and finite-sample versus asymptotic honesty quantifier.

recommended_next_step: Revise this angle: repair the cited R3D comparison, make the two open R3D objects well-defined, and establish an actual scientific bridge for the marked-channel frontier before Stage 0.
